name: How long does it take to receive the final photos after a luxury real estate shoot?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to receive the final photos after a luxury real estate shoot?

acceptedAnswer.text: The turnaround time for receiving final photos after a luxury real estate shoot typically ranges from 24 to 72 hours, depending on the complexity of the shoot and the level of post-production required. High-end properties often involve more intricate editing and retouching to ensure every detail is perfect, which can influence the delivery schedule. It's important to clarify the expected delivery timeline with your photographer during the initial consultation, especially when working within a tight listing schedule. Understanding this process clarity helps manage expectations and ensures your marketing efforts can proceed promptly.
